name: Oasis Semantics
description: Local-first embedding provider for memory-core, backed by an oasis-semantics sidecar. Speaks text (sentence-transformers: bge-small / bge-m3 / nomic / MiniLM) and multimodal (CLIP / SigLIP image+text in a shared vector space).
_contracts_NOTE_2026_07_11: The previous _contracts_NOTE (removed 2026-07-11) claimed that declaring `contracts.memoryEmbeddingProviders` makes the loader lazy-load /app/extensions/-mounted plugins and skips register(). Verified WRONG for openclaw 6.11: `src/plugins/registry.ts:1668-1694` REQUIRES the plugin to either have `kind: 'memory'` or declare `contracts.memoryEmbeddingProviders` — otherwise the `api.registerMemoryEmbeddingProvider(adapter)` call pushes a diagnostic and returns without writing to the global registry, so memory-core sees the provider as unknown. Only other reference to `contracts.memoryEmbeddingProviders` is `installed-plugin-index-record-builder.ts:47`, where it flips `sidecar: false` — i.e. declaring contracts makes the plugin an EAGER runtime plugin, the opposite of the lazy-load claim. This block re-declares the contract for 6.11 semantics.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the oasis-semantics HTTP server. Default: http://oasis-semantics:8732 (in-container) or http://127.0.0.1:8732 (host).

default_text_model.description: Tier name for text embeddings when memory-core does not pin one. Default: 'default' (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384-d, MIT).

default_mm_model.description: Tier name for multimodal embeddings when memory-core does not pin one. Default: 'clip-lite' (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32, 512-d, MIT).

bearer_token.description: Optional Bearer token for a hosted oasis-semantics endpoint. Not needed for the local sidecar.

request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Default: 60000 (60s).
